name: Vivid Vision
definition: A detailed, present-tense picture of your business and your life three years out, written as if it has already happened, using pictures, language, and storytelling.
principle: People and teams move toward a picture they can see. Vague goals pull no one forward. A vivid, specific future does.
whenUsed: When a founder is scaling, hiring, raising money, or feeling scattered, and needs the whole team rowing toward the same future.

name: The Vision Driven Method
definition: A single approach that fuses personal clarity and strategic business planning into one process, instead of treating them as two separate exercises.
principle: Business plans and life plans built apart from each other pull the founder in two directions. Built together, they compound.
whenUsed: When a founder keeps hitting revenue targets but not the lifestyle the business was supposed to fund.

name: The Vivid Vision Method
definition: The facilitated process Vision Driven runs clients through to extract, write, and design their three-year vision: Vivid Vision Clarity, the Vivid Vision Expander Day, Powerfully Articulate Your Vision, Vision Alive Imagery, and the Vivid Vision Rollout.
principle: A vision only works if it is captured, written well, made visual, and rolled out to the team. Each stage exists so the vision does not die in a notebook.
whenUsed: Start to finish of a Vivid Vision engagement.

name: The Golden Jail Cell vs. The Golden Compass
definition: The Golden Jail Cell is a business that is too big to walk away from but too dependent on you to give you freedom. The Golden Compass is the opposite: you always know where you are headed because you are guided by your own vision and values.
principle: Without a vision of your own, you end up playing someone else's game and trying to win it. With one, you play your own game.
whenUsed: Naming the exact trap a stuck-but-successful founder is in, and the way out.

name: The Big Life Stages of Entrepreneurship
definition: The arc founders move through, from an achievement-driven stage of chasing the next milestone to a vision-driven stage of leading from a clear picture of the life and business you want.
principle: Most founders never consciously graduate from achievement-driven to vision-driven, so they keep score with numbers that never feel like enough.
whenUsed: Helping a founder see where they are now and what the next stage actually looks like.

name: Vision Amplifier
definition: A 15-minute daily guided breathwork practice for connecting to your vision and staying in a creative, expansive state.
principle: A vision you look at once a year does not change your decisions. A daily practice keeps it live.
whenUsed: Ongoing, after the Vivid Vision is built.
